Meta.description: Automatic Street Fighter 6 session stats for your OBS stream.

Landing.subtitle: Wins, losses, win rate, MR and LP update automatically after every Ranked match. No hotkeys, no manual counters.
Landing.step1Body: We verify the player and read rank, LP and MR.
Landing.step2Body: Your current MR/LP and last match become the baseline.
Landing.step3Body: Browser Source → paste → done. Stats update by themselves.

Onboarding.help: Find it on Buckler's Boot Camp → your profile. It's the numeric User Code, not your fighter name.

obs.title: Add to OBS
obs.step5: OK — that's it. It updates by itself.
obs.recommendedBody: “Shutdown source when not visible”: off · “Refresh browser when scene becomes active”: off
obs.optionalNote: Optional — your stats live on the server, so a refresh or scene switch never resets them.

dev.description: Creates matches in the fake CFN. The worker detects them (≈1–2 s) and every open overlay updates without reloading.

error.body: The dashboard couldn't load. Your session keeps tracking in the background — nothing is lost.
